Class Window

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.window.Window
public final class Window extends Object
The entry point to THE ONE WINDOW — how a consumer obtains a typed handle to set or read behavior on anything addressable.

Menu-independent vs menu-bound

A panel, a panel element, and a created slot have ONE address everywhere they appear (rooted at a constant family by id), so handles to them need no menu and are reached statically — panel(String), element(String, String). This matters for a standalone screen that has panels but no AbstractContainerMenu at all: you still address its panels the same way.

Only a vanilla slot is identified by its position in a live menu, so addressing one by index needs that menu — view(AbstractContainerMenu) returns the menu-bound WindowView for slot(int) and friends.
